verdict.rationale: Docs describe pushing data into Typesense from primary databases/scrapers and a hands-on probe confirms a document can be indexed and immediately queried successfully (typo-tolerant search worked in under a second), supporting near-real-time indexing. However, there's no explicit documentation or evidence about update/delete latency, eventual consistency behavior across nodes, or reindexing requirements for schema changes. missing for 10: explicit docs/benchmarks on update and delete propagation latency, behavior under high write throughput, multi-node replication consistency guarantees, and confirmation that partial updates don't require full reindex.
